explanation: Sale of PPE: investing.

text: Interest received on a bank term deposit
explanation: In this game, interest received is investing, as Ind AS 7 requires for non-financial companies.

text: Cash collected from department-store customers for towels
explanation: Receipts from the core business: operating.
Payments for core operations: operating.
A core business payment: operating.
Taxes paid are operating unless clearly linked to investing or financing (IAS 7).

text: Purchase of a 10% stake in a dye supplier
explanation: An investment in another entity: investing.

text: Interest paid on the company's bank loan
explanation: In this game, interest paid is a financing cash flow, as Ind AS 7 requires for non-financial companies.
A change in borrowings: financing.
